note: What's New entries (modules/news.js reads this). Newest first is sorted by the module. Written by whoever ships a feature.

entries.title: Levels, Clips and accounts
items: Level up from 1 to 100: every match gives XP for kills, headshots, wins, the first win of the day and daily challenges.
New paper-clip currency: Clips. Earn them from matches, wins, level-ups and challenges (a shop is coming).
Pick a username and create a free account to keep your level and Clips on every device.
Unlock titles, paper banners, crosshair styles, calling cards and ribbon flair. Nothing changes how you play.

entries.title: Foldiers: first playable
items: Team Deathmatch on Desk Town, 4 vs 4 against bots.
Shoot thin cardboard to tear holes, cut peek holes with the knife, throw and catch paper planes.
